company.name: Ambiq Micro
company.shortDescription: Ambiq Micro is a semiconductor manufacturing company that develops mixed-signal solutions for wireless electronics.
company.description:
Ambiq Micro is an early-stage fabless semiconductor company that is developing ultra-low-power mixed-signal solutions for a new generation of wireless electronics.

Ambiq Micro was founded in 2010 on the simple yet powerful notion that extremely low-power semiconductors are the key to the future of electronics. Through the use of their pioneering ultra-low-power technology, they help innovative companies around the world develop differentiated solutions that reduce or eliminate the need for batteries, lower overall system power, and maximize industrial design flexibility.

aiResearchSummary.text: Ambiq Micro is developing very low power microcontroller systems and system on chip designs that use on-demand activation of memory paths during sleep or active modes, flexible and low power cache memory architecture, and memory modules with fine grained voltage adjustment capabilities. Work on adaptive voltage converter designs, systems for profiling power using ton pulses, and methods for generating power profile in low power processors supports efficient mixed signal solutions for wireless electronics.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Post IPO Equity round raised $179,400,000, or 27.62% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.
caveats: Crunchbase reports 23 rounds but provides 10 detailed rows.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 84 (-4 over 90 days) and market heat at 54 (-3).
